_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: BI-0C0B0836 adds record_owner_ruling: the only way a coworker can carry a ruling THE OWNER gave in chat onto an escalated decision review. record_decision_outcome cannot, because it records agreement with a kernel recommendation and an escalated review has none (refused no-recommendation on the COO, 2026-11-14), and the portal Answer controls are browser-session server actions. It is a declared proposal, so the escalation gate puts every call to a person, and it writes through the same core as the Answer controls, attributed to the human. Reuses decision_record_create; no new grant, core-tier entry or provider. Claim to check: owner-ruling-pack.test.ts proves the real gate returns human/declared-proposal even for a graduated, steered coworker, and that refusals (gate-resolved, unknown, foreign build, option not offered) write nothing. The prior 464-tool justification remains in the parent version.

registry.packFiles.reason: BI-0C0B0836: owner-ruling-pack.ts holds the single record_owner_ruling definition and handler. It is its own pack because it belongs to neither decision-outcome (agreement with a kernel recommendation) nor founder-review (read-only queue); it registers once in pack-registry.ts with grants matching agent-grants.ts. The prior 109-file justification remains in the parent version.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Adds the five names without which a core-tier client can start governed work but never finish it: update_backlog_item_status and record_execution_evidence (AGENTS.md s5 requires recording completion and its evidence, and core could create/triage/size/update but not close); trace_code_surface (a surface's implementation files and tests, pairing with search_code_graph which is already core); and claim_nonprod_environment_lease with release_nonprod_environment_lease together, since a session that can take the shared singleton lock but not release it blocks every other worktree and the CI gate. A client that cannot close its own work reaches for ?tier=full and pays the whole ~400-tool surface to recover two names. No effect on Claude Code or Codex, whose client-aware default is already full. Raise again only for a tool without which governed work cannot be finished; convenience stays behind search_tool_marketplace.
